chain_words.nuance: making small changes to existing arrangements
altering part of a text or rule to correct it
general improvement of a system or institution
thorough review and rebuilding of a whole system
changing a system so fundamentally that it is no longer the same

explanation: These words all describe changing a policy or system, but with different intensities, from minor adjustment to fundamental transformation.

usage_notes.difference: 'Reform' describes improving a system; 'overhaul' describes a thorough review and rebuilding of the whole system.
